grammar.title: Negation scope and focus
grammar.explain: Russian uses six-case government, verbal aspect, participial and adverbial-participial compression, impersonal constructions, evidential particles, information-structure word order, negation scope and formal–colloquial register. The model coordinates grammar with commitment, information structure, social distance, and cohesion; mediation must preserve those relations.
grammar.pattern: stance frame + scoped proposition + cohesive qualification

examples.t: Проблема заключалась не столько в самом решении, сколько именно в способе его воплощения.

examples.en: The problem lay not so much in the decision itself as precisely in the way it was implemented.

examples.en: His silence hardly meant agreement; rather, it revealed a deliberately maintained distance.

examples.t: Скорость необходима, спору нет; однако скорость без подотчётности — не прогресс, а отсроченный кризис.
